map.逐期折现计算净现值，展示每期现值、折现因子与累计现值，支持连续/年金模式: Discounts each period to compute the net present value, showing the present value, discount factor and cumulative present value per period, supporting both continuous and annuity modes
map.评估投资项目或设备购置时，将各期净现金流按折现率折算为当前价值，判断净现值是否大: When evaluating an investment project or equipment purchase, discount each period's net cash flow to the present value to judge whether the NPV is greater than zero.
map.比较互斥方案时，在相同的折现率下分别计算累计现值，择优选取净现值更高者。: When comparing mutually exclusive options, compute the cumulative present value at the same discount rate and pick the higher net present value.
map.做租赁与购买决策、分期收款估值时，用年金或逐期折现模式统一口径后横向对比。: For lease-versus-buy decisions and installment payment valuation, use the annuity or period-by-period discount mode to unify the convention before comparing.
map.：初始投资 100000 元，第 1~5 年净现金流分别为 25000、3000: Initial investment 100000 CNY with net cash flows of 25000, 30000, 35000, 30000 and 20000 CNY in years 1-5 at an 8% discount rate. The discount factors 1/(1.08)^t are 0.9259, 0.8573, 0.7938, 0.7350 and 0.6806; the present value total is about 25000 x 0.9259 + 30000 x 0.8573 + 35000 x 0.7938 + 30000 x 0.7350 + 20000 x 0.6806 = 23148 + 25719 + 27783 + 22050 + 13612 = 112312 CNY; NPV = 112312 - 100000 = 12312 CNY, above zero, so the plan is feasible.
map.折现率一般取多少？: What discount rate is usually used?
map.折现率可参考企业加权平均资本成本（WACC）、行业基准收益率或资金机会成本；风险: The discount rate can reference the weighted average cost of capital (WACC), an industry benchmark return or the opportunity cost of capital; the higher the risk the larger the value. When comparing schemes you must use the same discount rate for comparability.
map.年金模式和逐期模式有什么区别？: What is the difference between annuity mode and period mode?
map.年金模式假设每期现金流相等，用年金现值系数 P/A(r,n)=(1−(1+r)^: The annuity mode assumes equal cash flows each period and uses the present value factor P/A(r,n) = (1 - (1+r)^-n)/r to discount in one step; the period mode gives each cash flow individually and suits irregular amounts. Treat the period mode as authoritative, with the annuity mode only for equal-payment estimates.
